title: Critical dimension growth by width
statement: For each integer $w\geq0$, let $s_w$ be the greatest integer $s$ with $0\leq s\leq 2^{w+2}$ satisfying $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\leq 1/2$, taking $s_w=0$ if no such integer exists, and set $D_w=s_w w$. As $w\to+\infty$ through integers, $\frac{\log D_w}{w\log 2}$ tends to $1$.
hypotheses_covered: candidate sizes are restricted to integers from $0$ through $2^{w+2}$
